name: Nike Air Max 270
description: The Nike Air Max 270 features Nike's biggest heel Air unit yet for a super-soft ride that feels as impossible as it looks. The mesh upper provides breathability and comfort for all-day wear.
features: Pull tab at heel for easy entry

name: Adidas Ultraboost 22
description: Adidas Ultraboost 22 running shoes deliver incredible energy return with a responsive Boost midsole. Designed for serious runners who want performance and style in one package.
features: Full-length Boost midsole for energy return

name: Puma RS-X3
description: The Puma RS-X3 brings a bold, chunky silhouette with multi-layered upper and RS cushioning technology. A retro-inspired sneaker with modern comfort for everyday style.
features: RS cushioning technology in heel and forefoot

name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star
description: The iconic Converse Chuck Taylor All Star in classic canvas. Timeless high-top design with a rubber sole and signature star logo. A cultural staple since 1917.
features: Rubber toe cap and foxing stripe

name: Vans Old Skool
description: The Vans Old Skool is the original skate shoe and the first to feature the iconic Vans sidestripe. Canvas and suede upper with a padded tongue and collar for comfort.

name: New Balance 574
description: The New Balance 574 is a timeless classic with ENCAP midsole technology for superior support and durability. Suede and mesh upper with a comfortable cushioned insole.
features: ENCAP midsole for support and durability

name: Reebok Classic Leather
description: The Reebok Classic Leather features a soft leather upper for a natural fit and feel. Die-cut EVA midsole ensures lightweight cushioning and comfort for all-day wear.

name: Jordan 1 Retro High OG
description: The Air Jordan 1 Retro High OG brings back the original colorways of Michael Jordan's first signature shoe. Full-grain leather upper with Nike Air cushioning for a classic look.

name: Asics Gel-Nimbus 24
description: The Asics Gel-Nimbus 24 is a premium running shoe with GEL technology cushioning and FF BLAST+ midsole for a super-soft, responsive ride on long-distance runs.
features: GEL technology in rearfoot and forefoot

name: Saucony Ride 15
description: The Saucony Ride 15 offers PWRRUN cushioning for a smooth, balanced ride. Ideal for daily training runs with a breathable engineered mesh upper and durable outsole.

name: Nike Air Force 1 Low
description: The Nike Air Force 1 Low is the shoe that launched a revolution in basketball and street culture. Perforated leather upper with Nike Air cushioning for all-day comfort.
features: Woven tongue label with AF-1 logo

name: Adidas Stan Smith
description: The Adidas Stan Smith is a clean, minimal leather tennis shoe with a perforated 3-stripe design. Originally a tennis shoe, now a timeless streetwear essential worn worldwide.
features: Classic Stan Smith portrait on tongue

name: Brooks Ghost 15
description: The Brooks Ghost 15 is a versatile daily trainer with BioMoGo DNA and DNA LOFT v2 cushioning for a soft, smooth ride. Great for neutral runners at any pace.

name: Timberland 6-Inch Premium Boot
description: The Timberland 6-Inch Premium Boot is a waterproof nubuck leather boot with a padded collar and rustproof hardware. Built for rugged outdoor conditions and lasting durability.
features: Rustproof hardware and speed lace hooks

name: Dr. Martens 1460 Original
description: The Dr. Martens 1460 is the original eight-eyelet boot with smooth leather upper, Goodyear-welted construction, and the iconic yellow stitch. Built to last a lifetime.

name: Birkenstock Arizona Sandal
description: The Birkenstock Arizona is a two-strap sandal with a contoured cork-latex footbed that molds to the shape of your foot over time. Available in suede and leather.
features: Footbed molds to foot shape over time

name: Crocs Classic Clog
description: The Crocs Classic Clog is made with Croslite foam for all-day comfort. Ventilation ports add breathability and help shed water and debris. Lightweight and easy to clean.
features: Odor resistant and easy to clean

name: Salomon Speedcross 5
description: The Salomon Speedcross 5 is built for aggressive trail running with deep lugs for superior grip on soft, technical terrain. Quicklace system for easy on-the-go adjustments.
features: Deep chevron lugs for aggressive grip

name: Hoka Clifton 9
description: The Hoka Clifton 9 delivers an exceptionally lightweight, cushioned ride with a full-compression EVA midsole. The best daily trainer for runners seeking maximum comfort.

name: Nike Pegasus 40
description: The Nike Pegasus 40 is built for everyday running with React foam cushioning and a wider forefoot for a more natural feel. Mesh upper provides targeted breathability.

name: Adidas NMD_R1
description: The Adidas NMD_R1 combines Primeknit upper with Boost cushioning and molded EVA plugs for a futuristic look and responsive ride. A street-ready sneaker for urban explorers.

name: Puma Suede Classic
description: The Puma Suede Classic is a streetwear icon that has been worn by the most influential figures in sport, music, and fashion since 1968. Soft suede upper with rubber cupsole.

name: Under Armour HOVR Phantom 3
description: The UA HOVR Phantom 3 features HOVR technology to help maintain energy return while providing a 'zero gravity feel' that eliminates impact to keep you running longer.

name: Yeezy Boost 350 V2
description: The Adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 features a Primeknit upper with a distinctive side stripe and full-length Boost midsole for unmatched comfort. A highly sought-after collector's item.

name: Nike React Infinity Run 4
description: The Nike React Infinity Run 4 is designed to help reduce injury and keep you running. Wider base and React foam cushioning provide stability and a smooth heel-to-toe transition.
features: React foam midsole for plush cushioning

name: Reebok Nano X3
description: The Reebok Nano X3 is built for cross-training with a stable base, flexible forefoot, and breathable upper. Handles everything from weightlifting to HIIT with ease.
features: Wider toe box for natural splay

name: New Balance Fresh Foam 1080v13
description: The New Balance Fresh Foam 1080v13 features ultra-cushioned Fresh Foam X midsole for an incredible underfoot experience. Premium knit upper and a plush tongue for next-level comfort.
features: Hypoknit upper for support and stretch

name: Skechers GOwalk 6
description: The Skechers GOwalk 6 features ULTRA GO cushioning and HIGH REBOUND insole for superior comfort and energy return. Lightweight slip-on design perfect for walking.

name: On Cloud 5
description: The On Cloud 5 features CloudTec cushioning with a Zero-Gravity foam base for soft landings and explosive takeoffs. Lightweight and stylish for running and everyday wear.

name: Adidas Gazelle
description: The Adidas Gazelle is a classic suede sneaker with a slim profile and distinctive 3-stripe branding. Originally a training shoe, now a timeless lifestyle silhouette.

name: Nike Dunk Low
description: The Nike Dunk Low started as a basketball shoe and quickly became a canvas for artists and designers worldwide. Leather upper with Nike Air cushioning and a padded low-cut collar.

name: Vans Sk8-Hi
description: The Vans Sk8-Hi is the original high-top sneaker from Vans with a supportive ankle collar and waffle outsole. Canvas and suede upper with metal eyelets and D-ring lace loops.
features: Metal eyelets and D-ring lace loops

name: Jordan 4 Retro
description: The Air Jordan 4 Retro features mesh side panels, a visible Air unit, and lace wings for a bold, iconic look. One of the most revered sneakers in basketball and streetwear history.

name: Asics Gel-Kayano 30
description: The Asics Gel-Kayano 30 is a stability running shoe with GEL technology and 4D guidance system for overpronation control. Ideal for long-distance runners needing extra support.

name: Clarks Desert Boot
description: The Clarks Desert Boot is a two-eyelet suede chukka boot with crepe sole that has been a wardrobe staple since 1950. Simple, elegant, and endlessly versatile.

name: Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 3
description: The Nike ZoomX Vaporfly Next% 3 is engineered for elite marathon runners with a ZoomX foam midsole and carbon fiber plate for maximum energy return and record-breaking speed.

name: Adidas Samba OG
description: The Adidas Samba OG is a classic indoor soccer shoe turned streetwear staple. Leather upper with suede overlays, Trefoil logo tongue label, and a gum rubber outsole.

name: Hoka Bondi 8
description: The Hoka Bondi 8 is the brand's most cushioned road shoe, featuring a full EVA midsole and extended heel. Perfect for recovery runs and walking long distances in comfort.

name: Puma Cali Star
description: The Puma Cali Star is a platform sneaker with a chunky outsole and clean leather upper. Inspired by California lifestyle with a retro tennis aesthetic and modern comfort.

name: New Balance 990v6
description: The New Balance 990v6 is Made in USA with premium pigskin and mesh upper. ENCAP midsole technology offers the perfect combination of cushioning and stability for all-day wear.
features: ENCAP midsole for cushion and support

name: Nike Free Run 5.0
description: The Nike Free Run 5.0 features a flexible sole that expands and contracts with every movement. Lightweight mesh upper and minimal cushioning for a barefoot-like running experience.

name: Adidas Forum Low
description: The Adidas Forum Low is a retro basketball shoe with a leather upper and ankle strap for a vintage look. Originally released in 1984, now reimagined as a bold lifestyle sneaker.

name: Converse Run Star Hike
description: The Converse Run Star Hike features an exaggerated platform outsole with a jagged lug bottom. Canvas upper with Chuck Taylor heritage design elevated for a bold, modern aesthetic.

name: Saucony Kinvara 14
description: The Saucony Kinvara 14 is a lightweight, fast daily trainer with PWRRUN cushioning and a low heel-to-toe drop. Perfect for tempo runs and race day performance.

name: Jordan 11 Retro
description: The Air Jordan 11 Retro features a patent leather mudguard and full-length Air-Sole unit for on-court cushioning. Considered one of the most beautiful basketball shoes ever made.

name: Merrell Jungle Moc
description: The Merrell Jungle Moc is a slip-on shoe with a nubuck leather upper and Vibram outsole. Air cushion in the heel absorbs shock and adds stability for all-day comfort.

name: On Cloudrunner 2
description: The On Cloudrunner 2 provides structured support and CloudTec cushioning for runners who need stability without sacrificing speed. Breathable mesh upper and durable rubber outsole.

name: Reebok Club C 85
description: The Reebok Club C 85 is a clean leather tennis shoe with vintage styling. Die-cut EVA midsole and padded foam sockliner provide lightweight cushioning and comfort.

name: Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 2
description: The Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 2 is the pinnacle of marathon racing footwear. Twin Zoom Air pods and ZoomX foam beneath a carbon fiber plate deliver unmatched propulsion.

name: Vans Era
description: The Vans Era is a low-top lace-up shoe with a padded collar for comfort. Canvas upper with Vans waffle outsole provides excellent board feel for skateboarding.

name: Adidas Terrex Free Hiker 2
description: The Adidas Terrex Free Hiker 2 is a premium hiking boot with Continental rubber outsole and Boost midsole for cushioning on long trail adventures. Waterproof and durable.
features: Free Hiker 2.0 last for natural flex

name: Brooks Adrenaline GTS 23
description: The Brooks Adrenaline GTS 23 is a supportive daily trainer with GuideRails holistic support system to keep excess movement in check. Soft cushioning for an all-day comfortable ride.

name: Puma Clyde Court
description: The Puma Clyde Court is a basketball shoe with a leather upper and ProFoam midsole for responsive cushioning. Inspired by Puma's rich basketball heritage with Walt Clyde Frazier.

name: Nike Air Max 90
description: The Nike Air Max 90 stays true to its OG running roots with the iconic waffle outsole, stitched overlays, and classic TPU details. The Max Air unit returns to keep you comfortable.

name: Adidas Ultraboost Light
description: The Adidas Ultraboost Light is 30% lighter than standard Ultraboost with LIGHT BOOST foam. Linear Energy Push system and Continental rubber outsole for smooth, fast runs.

name: Salomon XT-6
description: The Salomon XT-6 is a technical trail running shoe adapted for the streets. Sensifit construction wraps the foot for precise hold, with Contagrip outsole for grip on any terrain.

name: Skechers D'Lites
description: The Skechers D'Lites features a chunky platform sole with leather and mesh upper. Memory Foam insole provides personalized comfort for all-day casual wear.

name: New Balance Minimus 10v1 Trail
description: The New Balance Minimus 10v1 Trail is a minimal trail running shoe with Vibram outsole for grip. Low 4mm drop promotes natural foot mechanics and ground feel.

name: Nike Metcon 9
description: The Nike Metcon 9 is built for cross-training with a flat, stable heel for weightlifting and a flexible forefoot for running. Hyperlift insert adds height for Olympic lifting.

name: Asics Gel-Resolution 9
description: The Asics Gel-Resolution 9 is a premium tennis shoe with GEL technology and a durable outsole designed for intense lateral movements on court. Provides exceptional stability.

name: Jordan 3 Retro
description: The Air Jordan 3 Retro introduced visible Air cushioning and the iconic elephant print detailing. The first Jordan designed by Tinker Hatfield, it remains a symbol of sneaker culture.

name: Hoka Speedgoat 5
description: The Hoka Speedgoat 5 is a premier trail running shoe with a Vibram Megagrip outsole and maximum cushioning for technical terrain. The choice of ultra-trail runners worldwide.

name: Adidas Yeezy Slide
description: The Adidas Yeezy Slide features an EVA foam construction with a textured footbed for enhanced traction. A minimalist one-piece design that has become a modern style staple.

name: Nike SB Dunk Low Pro
description: The Nike SB Dunk Low Pro is built for skateboarding with Zoom Air insole, padded tongue, and Solarsoft sockliner for enhanced cushioning and board feel.

name: Under Armour Charged Assert 10
description: The Under Armour Charged Assert 10 features Charged cushioning for an ultra-responsive ride. Lightweight mesh upper and durable outsole make it a great everyday training shoe.

name: Mizuno Wave Rider 27
description: The Mizuno Wave Rider 27 features Wave technology for shock absorption and stability. ENERZY foam midsole delivers softer, more responsive cushioning for daily training runs.

name: Reebok Freestyle Hi
description: The Reebok Freestyle Hi is the original women's fitness shoe that transformed aerobics in the 1980s. Garment leather upper with an ankle strap and low-cut construction.

name: Nike Blazer Mid 77
description: The Nike Blazer Mid 77 brings back a classic basketball silhouette with vintage styling cues including a cracked leather texture and retro Swoosh logo. High top ankle collar for support.
finish_note: Deliberate cracked leather finish for vintage look
features: Cracked leather texture for vintage look

name: Adidas Campus 00s
description: The Adidas Campus 00s is a retro-inspired lifestyle shoe with premium suede upper and a chunky vulcanized-look outsole. A nostalgic silhouette reimagined for contemporary fashion.

name: Puma Velocity Nitro 2
description: The Puma Velocity Nitro 2 features NITRO foam midsole for responsive cushioning and a propulsive ride. PUMAGRIP outsole provides reliable traction on wet and dry roads.

name: Saucony Jazz Original
description: The Saucony Jazz Original is a vintage running shoe with a suede and nylon upper and triangular cushioning pods. A timeless design worn by fashion-forward sneaker enthusiasts.

name: Jordan 6 Retro
description: The Air Jordan 6 Retro was Michael Jordan's shoe when he won his first NBA Championship. Clean lace lock and pull tab at the top and heel for easy entry and a secure fit.

name: Keen Newport H2 Sandal
description: The Keen Newport H2 is a closed-toe water sandal with quick-dry webbing upper and non-marking rubber outsole. Built for water adventures with a secure fit and toe protection.

name: Nike Air Huarache
description: The Nike Air Huarache features an inner bootie for a sock-like fit wrapped in a minimal upper. Air cushioning in the heel provides lightweight impact protection.

name: Asics Gel-Venture 9
description: The Asics Gel-Venture 9 is an affordable trail running shoe with GEL technology cushioning and a rugged outsole for grip on off-road terrain. Durable and reliable for beginners.

name: Brooks Levitate 6
description: The Brooks Levitate 6 features DNA AMP midsole for maximum energy return with every stride. Engineered mesh upper conforms to the foot for a responsive, energetic running experience.
features: DNA AMP midsole for energy return

name: Adidas Handball Spezial
description: The Adidas Handball Spezial is a vintage indoor sports shoe with a suede upper and distinctive gum sole. Originally designed for handball, now a must-have casual lifestyle silhouette.

name: Hoka Arahi 7
description: The Hoka Arahi 7 is a lightweight stability running shoe with J-Frame technology to guide the foot through a natural motion path. Ideal for overpronators seeking comfort and control.

name: Vans Authentic
description: The Vans Authentic is the first Vans shoe ever made. A low-top lace-up silhouette with canvas upper and Vans signature waffle outsole. Clean, classic, and versatile.

name: Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Trail 5
description: The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus Trail 5 brings Pegasus cushioning to the trails with a grippy lug outsole and reinforced overlays for protection on technical terrain.

name: New Balance 327
description: The New Balance 327 features a retro running design with an oversized N logo and split midsole. Suede and mesh upper gives this lifestyle shoe a vintage athletic aesthetic.

name: Puma Future Rider
description: The Puma Future Rider is a retro running shoe with a bold color-blocked design and SoftFoam+ midsole for all-day comfort. A heritage silhouette with a contemporary lifestyle appeal.

name: Under Armour Curry 11
description: The UA Curry 11 is Stephen Curry's signature basketball shoe with UA Flow outsole for lightweight grip and Warp upper for targeted support during explosive court movements.

name: Saucony Endorphin Speed 3
description: The Saucony Endorphin Speed 3 features a nylon plate and PWRRUN PB foam for a propulsive, fast ride. The go-to shoe for tempo runs, half marathons, and full marathons.

name: Converse One Star Pro
description: The Converse One Star Pro features a suede upper with a durable cupsole for skateboarding performance. The OrthoLite insole provides cushioning for long skate sessions.

name: Adidas Ozweego
description: The Adidas Ozweego combines retro styling with modern comfort featuring a chunky adiprene+ cushioned midsole and mesh and synthetic upper. A bold lifestyle sneaker.

name: Reebok Question Mid
description: The Reebok Question Mid is Allen Iverson's iconic signature shoe featuring Hexalite cushioning and a leather and mesh upper. A basketball classic that crossed over into street fashion.

name: Nike Air Max Plus
description: The Nike Air Max Plus features the iconic Tuned Air cushioning system with a distinctive cage upper. Originally designed for beach runners, now a streetwear staple.

name: Mizuno Wave Prophecy 12
description: The Mizuno Wave Prophecy 12 is the pinnacle of Mizuno running technology with an all-Wave plate running the full length of the shoe for maximum shock absorption and stability.

name: Jordan 5 Retro
description: The Air Jordan 5 Retro features a translucent outsole with a lace lock for a secure fit. Inspired by WWII fighter planes, the shoe has a distinctive shark-tooth midsole design.

name: Salomon Pulsar Trail Pro 2
description: The Salomon Pulsar Trail Pro 2 is a carbon-plated trail racing shoe with Energy Surge foam for maximum propulsion. Built for ultra-trail racing on technical mountain terrain.

name: Nike Air Zoom Structure 25
description: The Nike Air Zoom Structure 25 provides lightweight stability with a Dynamic Support System for a smooth, supported run. Ideal for mild to moderate overpronators.

name: Puma Deviate NITRO 2
description: The Puma Deviate NITRO 2 features NITRO Elite foam and a carbon fiber plate for high-speed performance. Race-ready design for runners targeting personal records.

name: Keen Targhee III Waterproof
description: The Keen Targhee III Waterproof is a rugged hiking boot with KEEN.DRY waterproof membrane and KEEN All-Terrain rubber outsole. Built for multi-day hiking adventures.

name: Nike Cortez
description: The Nike Cortez is the first shoe ever produced by Nike. A timeless classic with a leather upper, foam midsole, and rubber outsole. An enduring symbol of sport and culture.

name: Adidas Predator Accuracy.3 FG
description: The Adidas Predator Accuracy.3 features ZONE SKIN texture zones on the upper for enhanced ball control and shooting accuracy. Firm ground outsole for traction on natural grass.

name: Hoka Mach 6
description: The Hoka Mach 6 is a lightweight, versatile trainer with CMEVA midsole for a bouncy, energized ride. Perfect for tempo runs and race day with a propulsive rocker geometry.

name: Saucony Triumph 21
description: The Saucony Triumph 21 is the most cushioned shoe in the Saucony lineup with PWRRUN+ foam for a plush, balanced ride. Premium knit upper for an adaptive, comfortable fit.

name: Jordan 12 Retro
description: The Air Jordan 12 Retro was inspired by the Japanese Rising Sun flag and features a lizard skin-textured upper with a herringbone pattern outsole. A shoe worn by Jordan during his famous Flu Game.
